source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_APPENDIX::U01: Separate PMLA reporting duties from investigation and confiscation powers

payload.title: Identify whether the question concerns the bank duty or State power
payload.core_explanation_md:
PMLA research should first distinguish reporting-entity compliance from attachment, search, arrest, adjudication and confiscation. Identity verification, record maintenance and enhanced due diligence are not interchangeable with the authority power to seize or finally confiscate property.

For a compliance question, locate the duty together with applicable rules and dated regulatory directions. For a coercive measure, identify the authorised actor, grounds, procedure and review route. A suspicious transaction and a proven offence are different states of evidence. Preserve the actual facts and do not turn a short appendix heading into a customer-specific finding of guilt.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a reporting duty automatically authorise the bank to confiscate assets?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Those are different statutory roles.
